title: Local server: loopback bind, Host and Origin checks, path policy, body limits, hostile JSON, NPZ and GDS inputs

fixture.server: torchfdtd.server.create_app(<tmp>/results) driven in-process by fastapi.testclient.TestClient with raise_server_exceptions=False; the CLI entry torchfdtd.cli.main with uvicorn.run replaced by a recorder

loopback_bind.default: torchfdtd serve --port 8123 must call uvicorn.run with host 127.0.0.1

origins.accepted: http://testserver on /api/validate and a request without Origin

body_limits.declared_over_limit: JSON body of about 92 bytes with Content-Length

json_bodies: string where an integer is required
mesh 1e-9 um on the demo region
fixture.project_as_code: demo project whose name, material name and structure name carry Python and shell syntax; saved, reloaded and rendered through /api/python
npz_inputs: archive declaring frames of shape (2**40,) and fields of shape (2**30, 4, 6) in under 8 KiB
gds_inputs: layout plus a record after ENDLIB
AREF 4000 x 4000 of a one-rectangle cell converted through /api/gds/{key}/convert

seed: not applicable: every request and file is fixed in tests/test_server_security.py
backend: cpu; no simulation is run and no CUDA context is created by the case
reference_method: expected HTTP status codes and file-system state stated in docs/SECURITY.md; static source scan of torchfdtd/*.py for np.load(... allow_pickle=False), pickle.load, torch.load, eval, exec, os.system, subprocess and __import__

acceptance.bind: uvicorn.run receives host 127.0.0.1 by default and localhost when asked; every refused host exits the CLI with code 2 before uvicorn.run
acceptance.host_header: accepted hosts answer 200 on /api/capabilities; rejected hosts answer 400 with no capability payload
acceptance.origin: every listed origin answers 403 on every listed route and the job table stays empty; the server's own origin and a missing Origin answer 200 on /api/validate
acceptance.paths: every route key answers 404 or 405 without repository file content; the CSS asset answers 200; every static escape answers 404 without repository content; every accepted upload is stored under <results>/fsp/<32 hex>/ or <results>/gds/<32 hex>.gds and no file named escape* exists anywhere under the temporary directory
acceptance.body_limits: declared over-limit bodies answer 413 on JSON, GDS and FSP routes; a chunked body answers 411; every malformed Content-Length answers 400; a body under the limit is served
acceptance.json: every hostile body answers a 4xx status with a JSON detail; NaN, Infinity and 1e999 answer 422 mentioning finite; /api/capabilities and a valid project answer 200 afterwards
acceptance.code: the reloaded project keeps the hostile strings as data; a JSON key __reduce__ is refused; the generated script parses to ImportFrom, Assign, Assign, Expr, Expr calling only model_validate, Simulation, run, save and print with the hostile strings as string constants; the listed server modules contain no eval, exec, compile, os.system, subprocess, __import__ or importlib
acceptance.npz: every np.load call in the package passes allow_pickle=False and no module uses allow_pickle=True, pickle.load, torch.load, joblib.load or numpy.load; object archives raise ValueError mentioning allow_pickle; the declared-huge archive raises MemoryError or ValueError from Result.load and ValueError from the box loader within 5 s; the truncated archive raises BadZipFile, ValueError, OSError or EOFError
acceptance.gds: every hostile layout answers 422 on /api/gds/inspect; the 16-million-instance array is accepted by inspect and refused by convert at 422 mentioning admission limits within 30 s
acceptance.source_of_limits: docs/SECURITY.md; MAX_REQUEST_BYTES 32000000, gds_service.MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES 32000000, fsp.MAX_FSP_BYTES 134217728, GDSLimits defaults

not_yet_covered: a real uvicorn process bound and probed over TCP from a second process (the case drives the ASGI app in-process)
the optional vendor bridge routes /api/fsp/import and /api/fsp/{key}/export with an installed vendor API

notes: Declared before the run at 2b64f91. The controls added with this case are the 411 answer for chunked bodies, the 400 answer for a malformed Content-Length, the 422 rendering of NaN and Infinity inputs, the loopback-only --host choices and the static-file drive/UNC guard; the Host, Origin, declared-size, upload streaming, uuid storage and GDS admission controls existed before it.
